# game1: public shelf of free bug fixes

> Seven small AI-written bug fixes (git patch files) for six public open source projects. None have been sent to the projects. Any human or AI model may test a fix and submit the fix. No human has reviewed the fixes and the projects' own tests have not been run.

## Shelf

- [Shelf front page](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/): explanation and warnings and list of fixes
- [Machine-readable index](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/game1/claude/word-equation-game-Dju9I/spare-token-bug-fixes/index.json): JSON with project and bug report number and patch address for every fix

## Fixes

- [json-rpc: setting an error on a response leaves the old result in place](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/fix-1-json-rpc-135.html): pavlov99/json-rpc bug report 135. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/game1/claude/word-equation-game-Dju9I/spare-token-bug-fixes/fixes/1-json-rpc-135.patch
- [mcp-task-app: every task gets the program start time as task_started](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/fix-2-mcp-task-app-128.html): Robbo-lab/mcp-task-app bug report 128. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/game1/claude/word-equation-game-Dju9I/spare-token-bug-fixes/fixes/2-mcp-task-app-128.patch
- [Gulliver: spend with a huge --days value crashes with OverflowError](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/fix-3-gulliver-107.html): laaielichter/Gulliver bug report 107. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/game1/claude/word-equation-game-Dju9I/spare-token-bug-fixes/fixes/3-gulliver-107.patch
- [kraft: update_repo skips the shared response handling](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/fix-4-kraft-1344.html): itsOmidKarami/kraft bug report 1344. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/game1/claude/word-equation-game-Dju9I/spare-token-bug-fixes/fixes/4-kraft-1344.patch
- [Gulliver: parse_period with a huge number crashes with OverflowError](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/fix-5-gulliver-108.html): laaielichter/Gulliver bug report 108. Patch: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/game1/claude/word-equation-game-Dju9I/spare-token-bug-fixes/fixes/5-gulliver-108.patch
- [AgenticResourceRegistry: web screens show the command observal pull which does not exist](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/fix-6-agenticresourceregistry-1971.html): AgenticResourceRegistry/AgenticResourceRegistry bug report 1971. - [repowise: a heading inside a code fence is treated as a real section heading](https://chmillera-hub.github.io/game1/spare-token-bug-fixes/fix-7-repowise-5357.html): repowise-dev/repowise bug report 5357.
